id: # lane/divaudit: found by its door-roll probe (8,000 dev-summoned zombies at hard), root-caused

cause: seed 1, hard, a zombie dev-summoned one a tick: the 740th rolled baby and then onSpawnWithEgg's second jockey branch (a new EntityChicken, spawned into the world and mounted inside the egg path). Java's row 758 held the chicken (id 1968) with the zombie riding it; C drew the chicken's id but never added it (w.ents want 3 got 2, then 14,558 field mismatches to the end of the probe). serverreplay_summon_hostile adopted only the zombie's record and left the spawner's chicken record in its out list (serverreplay_summon_chicken_jockey, beside it, adopted both). Fixed: the chicken's record is adopted first (the higher id ahead in loadedEntityList), then the zombie, linked by sr_adopt_mob, and the out list restored; the summon's NBT-tag defaults (dimension, air, the child flag) stay on the zombie. Reach: dev summons and a villager a zombie infects (serverreplay.c's infection calls the same summon), about 0.25% of zombies (baby 5%, then a new chicken 5%)
